official.description: The Bicocca International Scholarship Programme (BISP) is reserved for international students resident abroad holding a foreign qualification who are admitted to one of the University of Milano-Bicocca's English-taught degree programmes. The university offers a total of 100 scholarships, five dedicated to each international course, each worth €10,000 per academic year gross plus exemption from tuition fees.
official.program_type: University merit scholarship for international students admitted to English-taught degree programmes, awarded automatically through the admission ranking

applicant_utility.summary: There is no scholarship form to fill in: your admission application to one of the 17 listed English-taught programmes through apply.unimib.it is what enters you into the selection, so the real deadline is your programme's admission-confirmation date (15 March 2026 for free-entrance courses in the last cycle). Even as a beneficiary you still pay the administrative fee and the regional tax, and the €10,000 gross stipend is taxable income under Italian regulation. The multi-year headline is conditional: renewal is blocked unless you bank 40 ECTS by November 2027 and 60 ECTS by March 2028, with credits carried over from previous studies excluded, so only applicants confident of a full-time, on-schedule study plan should count on years two and three.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving international applicants to Milano-Bicocca's English-taught STEM, data science and economics programmes who can fund their first months in Milan before the first instalment arrives.
application_readiness_checklist: Apply in the FIRST Call for Admission - priority is explicitly given to those candidates, and later calls weaken your position
Confirm the admission offer and pay the deposit before your programme's deadline (15 March 2026 for free entrance in the 2026/27 cycle)
Open an Italian or SEPA bank account before the first instalment (due by December 2026 for the first year)
Check that you hold no other grant - regional DSU benefits, housing supplements and meal cards are all incompatible and force a choice within ten days
Plan travel so you are physically in Milan by 31 October 2026, otherwise the first instalment is not paid
common_rejection_risks: Being resident in Italy in any form - even legally for a non-EU citizen with a permit to stay, or an EU citizen resident for more than nine months, removes eligibility outright
Having previously enrolled in a master's degree programme in Italy, or enrolling in single courses or part-time
Failing to confirm the admission offer by the programme's deadline, which voids the automatic scholarship entry
Holding or later winning an incompatible grant (DSU regional scholarship, housing, meal card) without exercising the right of choice in time
Missing the ECTS renewal milestones, which triggers full withdrawal and a refund obligation for amounts already received
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Regional tax and administrative fee, Milan living costs beyond the €10,000 annual stipend, flight to Milan, visa (D) costs for non-EU students, and tax on the gross stipend.
document_audit: The deposit receipt is what proves you accepted the offer - keep the payment proof from apply.unimib.it
Enrolment happens only after the university checks document authenticity and enrolment eligibility, so diplomas and transcripts must be exactly as issued
The Declaration of Acceptance must be signed as part of the first instalment conditions; a missing signature stalls payment
All award communications arrive exclusively through the Dream Apply platform and your registered e-mail - monitor both, not just the website
alerts: If you withdraw or miss renewal credits you must refund the money received, though you keep the tuition exemption for the year of reference
Study suspension is possible but cannot exceed one academic year and must be requested by e-mail to international.promotion@unimib.it

The award is incompatible with international mobility grants only in combination with other public/private grants - it is compatible with mobility grants themselves, so an Erasmus-style semester does not automatically cost you the scholarship
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: One submission only - the admission application on apply.unimib.it; scholarship offers, acceptance steps and instalment paperwork then run entirely through Dream Apply e-mail messaging.

Possible further integrations, subject to availability of funds

Not fall within any of the published grounds for exclusion from assistance

Eligibility does not guarantee the stipend: regional funds are limited, so eligible students may remain non-recipients until further funds become available (approximately December 2028)

official.description: The ISU Bocconi Scholarship is Bocconi University's implementation of the Italian Right to University Education scholarship for students entering the first year of a Bachelor of Science, Integrated Master of Arts in Law or Master of Science programme in a.y. 2027-28. It combines a cash stipend set annually by the Lombardy Region with services and supplements - a free daily meal, preferential-rate canteen access and a 200-hour work-study programme - and tests three separate requirements: enrolment, economics and ex post merit.
official.program_type: Need-based Right to University Education scholarship (cash stipend plus services and supplements), funded by the Lombardy Region and administered by the Fees, Funding and Housing Office

applicant_utility.summary: This is a means-tested need-based grant, not a merit award, and its cash value for 2027-28 does not exist yet - the Lombardy Region resolution expected between June and July 2027 sets both the economic thresholds and the stipend amounts, so the last published scale (€1,124-€7,229 by residence status and ISU bracket for 2026-27) is only a planning reference. International applicants must start the ISEEU Parificato process with Bocconi's partnered CAF months in advance, because the first window (12-30 November 2026) accepts only the CAF's confirmation e-mail, with the corrected certificate due by 11 January 2027. The benefit is only confirmed after you pass 44 credits (BSc/Law) or 39 credits (MSc) by 10 August 2028, and it must be re-applied for every single year.
applicant_utility.best_fit: International and non-resident students with genuine financial need (family ISEEU Parificato below the regional thresholds) who can begin CAF paperwork in autumn 2026 and hold a full-time study plan.
application_readiness_checklist: Contact Bocconi's partnered CAF as soon as submissions open on 11 November 2026 if you need an ISEEU Parificato - the Early Session window closes 30 November 2026 and only takes the CAF e-mail
Check the deadlines page, not the portal: dates inside the online procedure are system defaults and official deadlines are only those on the deadlines page
Map your window to your admission session (Early/HEC, Winter, Spring for BSc-Law; rounds 1-4 for MSc) and diarise the close date
Sign every uploaded document by hand exactly as on the ID you upload, and complete enrolment for a.y. 2027-28 before applying
Have an Italian current account in your own name and enter the details on Punto Blu by 30 September 2027; payment is impossible without it
common_rejection_risks: Submitting after the window closes or through a different modality - such applications are not evaluated at all
An ISEE/ISEEU Parificato issued in the wrong year, or values above the regional thresholds, which will only be published in June-July 2027 and may differ from the 2026-27 limits
Being enrolled 'with reserve', which blocks visibility of the benefit and the refund of the first advance payment until the reserve is lifted (by 30 November 2027)
Missing the ex post credit thresholds (44/39 credits by 10 August 2028), which revokes the benefit even after payment
Withdrawing, transferring to another university during the year, or failing to send original documents by registered mail when the Office requests them - all trigger forfeiture
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition and fees for international students (the ISU award itself carries no tuition benefit), Milan housing deposit and rent, flights, and living costs above the stipend, which is paid only in two instalments from late December 2027.
document_audit: The submitted ISEE/ISEEU Parificato is final - no supplement, rectification, replacement or update is accepted unless the Fees, Funding and Housing Office expressly requests it, so an error in the fiscal code or issue/protocol data can sink the application

Independent-student claims need a full evidence chain: CU and tax declarations for 2025 and 2026, two years of family registration certificates, and a registered rental agreement at an address different from your parents'
Any entrepreneurial or company activity at 31/12/2025 requires the accountant-signed financial statement form (or a Declaration of Absence), with the amounts also declared in the DSU
Disability increases (up to 40%) require documentation issued by a competent Italian medical committee, not a foreign certificate
alerts: The 2027-28 stipend amount, brackets and ISEE thresholds will only be published after the Lombardy Region resolution expected June-July 2027 - do not budget on the 2026-27 figures
For first-year recipients the second instalment is not paid before October 2028 and only if the credit threshold was met on 10 August 2028
Regional funding is limited: eligible students can end up as non-recipients, with money possibly only arriving by December 2028
The regional tax reimbursement is credited by the end of December 2027 together with the refund of the first instalment-advance
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Fill the online form inside your fixed window, upload signed documents, submit; results follow provisional ranking mid-October 2027 and final ranking end-October 2027, then two wire-transfer instalments to an Italian account.
